meaning:
§ Pi-hahiroth = "place where sedge grows"
the 3rd encampment of the Israelites after leaving Goshen in Egypt and the last one before crossing the Red Sea

elsewhere.note: “Speak to the children of Israel, that they turn back and encamp before Pihahiroth, between Migdol and the sea, before Baal Zephon. You shall encamp opposite…
They traveled from Etham, and turned back to Pihahiroth, which is before Baal Zephon, and they encamped before Migdol.
